prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA and catboost tie for trend champion with 0.0 correlation (highest among all models), while rf dominates seasonality with 0.4475 correlation. rf is also the overall champion with lowest RMSE (778.29). However, the series is highly unpredictable (spectral entropy 0.9147), rankings are extremely unstable (Kendall τ 0.0058), and model disagreement is severe (RMSE spread ratio 2.40). These conditions strongly favor robust combiners like median or trimmed mean over weighted stacking, which would overfit noise in this volatile environment.
